researchSummary: Ten names across eight sectors plus a 10% SPY residual. The book leans toward the multi-sleeve quality/growth leaders (NVDA, MSFT, META, LLY, V), with diversification from NEM (gold), XOM (energy) and BKNG (a value-sleeve rebound), and every weight is sized for vol and scaled by the cohort-relative entry haircut. Megacap-tech cluster: 42% direct (NVDA 15, MSFT 12, META 9, AAPL 6), about 45.8% counting SPY look-through, under the 48% cap. Defensive total: 0% direct, because LLY's 0.44 range fails the vol gate and NEM, V and XOM are not in defensive clusters; about 1% look-through via SPY. Turnover: GOOGL, AMZN, AVGO and JNJ did not reach the verified survivor set this cycle, so the churn governor keeps them one more cycle as phase-out positions with no new money; this is not a broken-thesis call. MA and UNP complete their two-strike phase-out because neither re-qualified, also not a broken-thesis call, and V absorbs the payments exposure. VTI stays untouched as the parking vehicle. Risk posture follows Mandate A: no ballast, and downside is controlled by the cluster caps, ~9-11% stops and the relative drawdown breaker. Weights are pre-finalize: finalize will renormalize them with the four phase-out retentions and re-check the megacap cap.
